name: mapgis-local-agent
description: Local MapGIS file operations, geological map plans, cartographic checks, and GIS interchange.
long_description: Launches the hybrid MapGIS MCP surface in the selected local Python environment. Native MapGIS 6.7 operations use an exact-build installation and a package-local configuration in the task directory.

python_executable.title: Local Python executable
python_executable.description: Select Python from the MapGIS Agent checkout environment or the offline share with dependencies installed.

task_root.title: MapGIS task directory
task_root.description: A writable local task folder. Supply its package-local MapGIS configuration for licensed native operations.
